name: App Glass
author: lung595
description: Translucent glass backgrounds for desktop apps on niri: terminals, GTK3, GTK4, Qt 6 and some Electron and WebKitGTK apps. The level follows the DMS window opacity, text and icons stay opaque, unfocused windows fade a little more. Per-app switches and a bar pill with a pause. Writes the apps' own colour files, launchers in ~/.local/share/applications, a niri rule file, a matugen hook and user systemd units; every write is backed up and uninstalling from DMS puts the files back.
